arxiv-1409-0349.title: A framework of the harmonic Arnoldi method for evaluating φ \varphi -functions with applications to exponential integrators
arxiv-1409-0349.description: Abstract In recent years, a great deal of attention has been focused on numerically solving exponential integrators. The important ingredient to the implementation of exponential integrators is the efficient and accurate evaluation of the so called φ \varphi -functions on a given vector. The Krylov subspace method is an important technique for this problem.

arxiv-2012-13636.description: Abstract We investigate the T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -like flows for non-linear electrodynamic theories in D ( = 2 ​ n ) D(=\!\!2n) -dimensional spacetime. Our analysis is restricted to the deformation problem of the classical free action by employing the proposed T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} operator from a simple integration technique.

arxiv-2104-14202.title: Bayesian Deep Neural Networks for Supervised Learning of Single-View Depth
arxiv-2104-14202.creator: Javier Rodríguez-Puigvert, Rubén Martínez-Cantín, Javier Civera
arxiv-2104-14202.description: Abstract Uncertainty quantification is essential for robotic perception, as overconfident or point estimators can lead to collisions and damages to the environment and the robot. In this paper, we evaluate scalable approaches to uncertainty quantification in single-view supervised depth learning, specifically MC dropout and deep ensembles.

arxiv-2212-11148.title: Charm fluctuations in (2+1)-flavor QCD at high temperature
arxiv-2212-11148.description: Abstract Using the high statistics datasets of the HotQCD Collaboration, generated with the HISQ (2+1)-flavor action for light and strange quarks, and treating the charm sector in the quenched approximation, we analyze the second and fourth order cumulants of charm fluctuations and the correlations of charm with lighter conserved flavor quantum numbers.

arxiv-2501-14126.title: Generalized cell maps
arxiv-2501-14126.creator: Carlos Islas, Benjamín A. Itzá-Ortiz, Rocío Leonel
arxiv-2501-14126.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Carlos Islas, Benjamín A. Itzá-Ortiz, Rocío Leonel. In [ 6 ] the notion of a g-cell structure was introduced as a generalization of the construction proposed by Debski and Tymchatyn to realize a certain class of topological spaces as quotient spaces of inverse limits. In [ 2 ] , cell maps are defined between cell structures and showed that a cell map between two complete cell structures induces a continuous function between the spaces determined by the cell structures.

arxiv-2506-16347.title: Emission Impossible: privacy-preserving carbon emissions claims Conference: ; Dec 03, 2024; Glasgow, Scotland, UK
arxiv-2506-16347.creator: Jessica Man, Sadiq Jaffer, Patrick Ferris, Martin Kleppmann, Anil Madhavapeddy
arxiv-2506-16347.description: Abstract . Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) have a significant climate impact, and data centres account for a large proportion of the carbon emissions from ICT. To achieve sustainability goals, it is important that all parties involved in ICT supply chains can track and share accurate carbon emissions data with their customers, investors, and the authorities.

arxiv-2507-02839.title: Stiefel optimization is NP-hard
arxiv-2507-02839.creator: Zehua Lai, Lek-Heng Lim, Tianyun Tang
arxiv-2507-02839.description: Abstract . We show that linearly constrained linear optimization over a Stiefel or Grassmann manifold is NP-hard in general. We show that the same is true for unconstrained quadratic optimization over a Stiefel manifold. We will establish the nonexistence of FPTAS \mathrm{FPTAS} for these optimization problems over a Stiefel manifold. As an aside we extend our results to flag manifolds.

pmc-10625494.title: Marginalized, but not demobilized: Ethnic minority protest activity when facing discrimination
pmc-10625494.creator: Antoine Bilodeau, Stephen E White, Clayton Ma, Luc Turgeon, Ailsa Henderson
pmc-10625494.description: In a context of backlash against diversity in many countries, we know little about how ethnic minorities respond politically when they personally experience discrimination. Moving beyond the study of electoral participation, this research investigates whether experiences of discrimination push ethnic minorities toward an alternate political pathway for those who feel sidelined by the political community: protest activity.

pmc-12641739.title: Effectiveness of Different Types of Core Decompression in Early-Stage Osteonecrosis of the Femoral Head: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12641739.creator: Wojciech Konarski
pmc-12641739.description: Background: Osteonecrosis of the femoral head is a progressive disorder leading to femoral head collapse and early disability, often affecting young adults. Core decompression (CD) is the most established hip-preserving treatment for early-stage disease, yet the comparative benefits of biological and structural augmentation remain uncertain.

pmc-12946564.title: Monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 from a conditioned medium of bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells promotes bone regeneration by enhancing macrophage phenotype polarization
pmc-12946564.creator: Kosuke Hashizume, Wataru Katagiri, Ryoko Takeuchi, Daisuke Suda, Tadaharu Kobayashi
pmc-12946564.description: BackgroundWe have reported that the cytokines and chemokines contained in conditioned medium of human mesenchymal stem cells (MSC-CM), which were derived from bone marrow, promote bone regeneration. We recently reported macrophage phenotype polarization towards the anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype induced by MSC-CM and its potential to establish regenerative condition and assist subsequent bone regeneration.

pmc-13409394.description: Background/Objectives: The accurate detection of the anterior loop (AL) of the inferior alveolar nerve is critical to avoid neurosensory complications during surgical procedures in the interforaminal region, and panoramic radiography continues to be widely used in routine dental diagnostics due to its accessibility and cost-effectiveness.

pmc-13439443.title: 补肾益精方可减轻秀丽隐杆线虫β淀粉样蛋白沉积及氧化损伤
pmc-13439443.creator: Yunwei LU, Deyu LI, Yingchao HU, Lei LU, Guran YU, 方 余, 洁 沈
pmc-13439443.description: 目的探讨补肾益精方对秀丽隐杆线虫β淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）沉积及氧化损伤的改善作用。方法采用秀丽隐杆线虫模型（N2野生型、CL4176、TJ356和LG333转基因线虫）。将方药饮片经水提、冷冻干燥制成冻干粉，以不同浓度加入培养基干预线虫，并以百草枯诱导建立N2线虫氧化应激模型。观察N2线虫寿命、CL4176线虫瘫痪时间及其咽部Aβ沉积量；试剂盒检测N2线虫总抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽、丙二醛和活性氧水平；吖啶橙染色评估N2线虫体内细胞凋亡；荧光显微镜观察TJ356线虫体内DAF-16::GFP和LG333线虫SKN-1::GFP核转位；并通过分子对接及分子动力学模拟分析有效成分梓醇、四氢鸭脚木碱（THA）与核心靶点FOXO、Nrf2的结合稳定性。结果与正常对照组比较，补肾益精方组可显著延长氧化应激及正常状态下N2线虫寿命（均P<0.01）。与模型对照组比较，补肾益精方组可延缓CL4176线虫瘫痪时间并减少其咽部Aβ沉积（均P<0.01）。与百草枯诱导的N2线虫氧化损伤对照组比较，补肾益精方组N2线虫总抗氧化能力、SOD、CAT和谷胱甘肽水平均升高（均P<0.01），丙二醛和活性氧水平均降低（均P<0.05），细胞凋亡亦减少。该方还可促进TJ356线虫体内DAF-16核转位及LG333线虫体内SKN-1核转位（均P<0.01）。梓醇、THA与核心靶点FOXO、Nrf2的结合自由能均低于－7.00 kcal/mol，分子动力学模拟证实FOXO-梓醇、Nrf2-梓醇和Nrf2-THA复合物稳定性和亲和力高。结论补肾益精方可能通过稳定结合并调控FOXO/Nrf2信号通路减轻线虫Aβ沉积及其神经毒性，增强抗氧化活性，减轻氧化应激损伤。Keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 补肾益精方, β淀粉样蛋白, 氧化应激, 秀丽隐杆线虫 随着人口老龄化问题加重，神经退行性疾病给社会带来了极大的经济负担。AD是痴呆的主要病因，2018年全球痴呆患者约为5000万人，预计到2050年将增至1.52亿［1］。我国目前存在1000多万AD患者，给社会和家庭带来了巨大的负担［2］。尽管临床上已采用针对胆碱能或谷氨酸能神经传导的药物如多奈哌齐，以及通过调节肠道菌群代谢产物影响脑内神经炎症的药物如甘露特纳（GV-971）治疗AD，但目前这些药物的临床疗效均未得到证实［3］。药物治疗AD的瓶颈可能与临床启动治疗过晚及对AD致病机制复杂性估计不足有关。 中医药治疗具有整体观及多靶点的特点，更符合AD的演变规律和疾病特点。补肾益精方（专利号：CN202010088959.0）是江苏省中医院于顾然教授的经验方，也是江苏省中医院院内制剂补肾益精合剂（苏药制备字Z2022009000）的组方基础，具有补肾益精填髓之功效。临床观察显示其对延缓AD进展、改善临床症状疗效明显，一系列前期实验研究也证实其具有保护AD患者血脑屏障及神经功能的作用［4-6］。但是，补肾益精方在治疗AD过程中发挥作用的靶点及机制尚不明确。淀粉样斑块是AD的神经病理学标志，在AD发病机制中起关键作用，其中Aβ的产生和沉积受遗传和环境因素的共同调控［7］。前期体外研究发现补肾益精方可通过PI3K/Akt/Nrf2信号通路减轻Aβ引起的神经细胞氧化应激损伤［8］。本实验利用AD的重要模式生物秀丽隐杆线虫探讨补肾益精方减少Aβ沉积及抗氧化应激的作用，以期进一步阐明补肾益精方对AD的作用机制。
